title: [3.0-beta2] Pod failure during 1st pod deactivation
body:
Installed 3.0beta2 today, going from beta1 with an active Dash pod. Had to change the pod a few hours later. As the pod was deactivating (after it connected but before the process finished) I got an "unknown pod failure" announcement along with the scream of death on both phone and pod for a few seconds. When the deactivation finished both stopped screaming but the phone kept playing an alert sound every second. Then a system notification reading just "none" popped up, which I swiped away. At this time there was no alert inside AAPS to dismiss/snooze visible and no apparent way to get rid of the alert. I tried exiting the app, then filling and activating the new pod as fast as I could, but the "be bop be bop" didn't stop until I shut down the phone and restarted it. 

This happened at 22.23
